articles.title: Two Giant Black Holes From Long Ago
articles.summary: Two giant black holes were found shining side by side just 900 million years after the Big Bang.

articles.title: Potatoes Grow in Moon Dust
articles.summary: Scientists grew potatoes through their whole life cycle in fake moon dust mixed with rich compost.

articles.title: A Tiny Spider With More DNA Than You
articles.summary: A tiny California spider named after Stephen Colbert has a genome about 50 percent larger than a human's.
